hml_semantic_commit_note: src/ is byte-identical from this commit through every later experiment/report commit on hml/vnext-semantic-coverage; pin the full hash at consumption time and stop on mismatch

neutral_schema_requirements.source_record: immutable; problem block and per-step spans each carry SHA-256; a span whose recomputed hash disagrees with the published hash is refused before use
neutral_schema_requirements.initial_state_premises: every source premise cited by any later transition receives a stable neutral id, proposition, origin (SOURCE_PROBLEM | SOURCE_INITIAL_STATE | EARLIER_SOURCE_TRANSITION | EXPLICIT_SOURCE_STATE_OMITTED_BY_OLD_SEGMENTER) and provenance hash, corpus-wide, never only for partition-bearing problems

branch_ancestry.rule: linear predecessor is never semantic dependency; rejected linear edges are recorded and never reused as ancestry

implicit_logical_steps.when: exhaustive branches establish unequal conclusions and the source publishes their union
implicit_logical_steps.insert: one weakening transition per branch, then close each branch on the common union, then the existing join
implicit_logical_steps.determinism: premise = the branch's own established conclusion; conclusion = the source's union proposition, or for inner levels the deterministic disjunction of sibling conclusions in declared branch order; no arithmetic, no creativity, no reading ahead beyond the union step the source contains
implicit_logical_steps.whitelist_extension: only by amending this contract, never by translator judgment

Claim.notes: exactness/approximation optional; absent means unannotated and is byte-stable for legacy records

Candidate.notes: evidence_id and verification_result are verifier-owned; a producer never writes them

Branch.notes: scope is the PARENT frame; the branch's own frame is branch:{key}; partition_id is a descriptive grouping label; coverage_obligation_id is the declared coverage debt

EvidenceRecord.notes: trusted is provenance, never permission; status is external ground truth only under offline replay; at runtime acceptance requires attestation

Action.notes: operation and summary are labels; typed effects are the semantics; summary is presentation-only and read by nothing in the verifier

allowed_state_effects.unrecognised_kinds: fail closed with the family's error class

candidate_lifecycle.creation: born PROPOSED only, with >=1 existing constraint, non-empty origin, active scope, dependencies subset of the action's
candidate_lifecycle.derivation: a step continuing an existing candidate creates a NEW candidate with a fresh id, inheriting the original constraints; candidate history is never mutated destructively
candidate_lifecycle.update: constraints and dependencies may only grow; settled candidates are immutable
candidate_lifecycle.rejection: requires accepted evidence naming refuted constraints the candidate actually carried; rejected candidates remain in the state
candidate_lifecycle.promotion: verifier-owned; checks EVERY original constraint; may publish only the proposition it verified; a translator never promotes

branch_protocol.shape: declare partition (an ordinary Obligation) -> open sibling branches from the declared common pre-split state -> branch-local assumption ASSUMED in the fresh frame -> reason inside the frame -> close each branch on a proposition its frame established -> join under the common-conclusion rule, discharging every named coverage debt in the same transition
branch_protocol.coverage: unconditional: a branch that names a coverage_obligation_id owes it; the obligation must exist, be OPEN, and be discharged by the join; one case analysis carries one debt
branch_protocol.no_disjointness_requirement: coverage is the obligation; overlap is not
branch_protocol.unequal_conclusions: resolved compositionally via implicit_logical_steps; no disjunctive-join primitive exists (D-063)
branch_protocol.nesting: supported; a nested branch's parent frame must be open; inner joins publish into the parent branch's frame
branch_protocol.leakage: branch-local facts never cite into or publish outside frames that do not contain them; escapes require a declared, evidenced scope discharge

exactness_protocol.axis: independent of ClaimStatus; None = unannotated, UNKNOWN = annotated-undeterminable
exactness_protocol.immutability: exactness and the approximation record are immutable once annotated; APPROXIMATE->EXACT and EXACT->APPROXIMATE in place are both forbidden
exactness_protocol.sourced: source_claim_id must be a declared dependency and the source claim must survive byte-identical
exactness_protocol.unsourced: legal (measured constants, side calculations) but must carry method or provenance; never invent an error bound the source does not state
exactness_protocol.laundering: an EXACT conclusion from APPROXIMATE premises requires the declared EXACT_FROM_APPROXIMATE effect with a non-empty justification

goal_protocol.supported: discharge only: goal_effect {kind: DISCHARGE, goal_id}; the goal must exist, end DISCHARGED, and the discharging claim must state the goal's proposition
goal_protocol.creation: not licensed at 68178f0; a goal appearing in state_after is refused by the frame; goal/subgoal lifecycle is specified (VNEXT_GOAL_SPEC.md) and deliberately unimplemented
goal_protocol.claimed_conclusion: when present must equal the produced claim's proposition exactly; summary never participates

obligation_protocol.creation: declared via obligations_created; licensed by the frame for exactly the declared ids
obligation_protocol.discharge: declared via obligations_discharged as {id, evidence_id}; must materialise as DISCHARGED; cited evidence is checked through the acceptance seam
obligation_protocol.deletion: never licensed; a mandatory obligation removed from state_after is a structural violation regardless of evidence status (D-062)

scope_protocol.containment: a conclusion may never be wider than the narrowest premise it rests on; global is the root; branch frames derive ancestry from Branch.scope
scope_protocol.active_scopes: under the frame condition: opening/retiring a frame is licensed only by the branch protocol's OPEN/CLOSE; undeclared mutation is INVALID
scope_protocol.escape: leaving a frame requires scope_effect DISCHARGE with accepted evidence

dependency_rules.claims_only: action.dependencies cite claims present in state_before; candidates are never dependencies — candidate lineage is carried in candidate records, not dependency edges
dependency_rules.produced_claim: the produced claim's dependencies equal the action's declared dependencies
dependency_rules.warrant_envelope: warrant evidence premise_ids equal the action's dependency list exactly, order included
dependency_rules.sibling_cases: opening dependencies come from the declared pre-split state; the linear predecessor is rejected, never reused

provenance_rules.spans: every transition carries its source span hash; recompute before use; mismatch is refusal
provenance_rules.ids: the source's fresh transition/output ids are preserved; synthetic protocol steps (declare/open/close inserted by translation) are suffix-marked and never reuse source ids
provenance_rules.implicit_steps: origin IMPLICIT_LOGICAL_STEP plus the span hash of the source step that necessitated them
provenance_rules.approximation: the approximation record is the provenance and is immutable
provenance_rules.summary: may carry source prose for humans; carries no authority and is excluded from training views

modes.OFFLINE_REPLAY: recorded status is external ground truth from a frozen adjudicated corpus
modes.RUNTIME: recorded status is ignored; acceptance requires attestation minted by the checking machinery

evidence_rules.acceptance: record exists, supports the rule applied, binds the exact premise envelope, status/attestation valid; trusted flag is never authority
evidence_rules.source_warrant: an untrusted worked-solution step is UNKNOWN evidence; expect UNRESOLVED, never fabricate VALID

unknown_rules.field_unknown: a status/domain/conclusion the invariants would have to read: transition is UNRESOLVED, checks short-circuit
unknown_rules.evidence_unknown: suppresses only warrant-class findings; structural violations (forged status, unlicensed frame change, deletion, leak) are reported regardless
unknown_rules.scope: only unknowns on records the action cites count; unrelated unknowns never disable the verifier

refusal_codes.MISSING_SOURCE_PREMISE: a cited premise has no declared neutral id; never reconstruct from linear adjacency
refusal_codes.AMBIGUOUS_BRANCH_PARENT: the pre-split state or parent frame of a case is not declared
refusal_codes.MISSING_BRANCH_COVERAGE: a case analysis has no declared coverage obligation
refusal_codes.UNSUPPORTED_CANDIDATE_TRANSITION: a candidate move outside the lifecycle table (including any translator-side promotion)
refusal_codes.UNREPRESENTABLE_APPROXIMATION: an approximation whose method/error/provenance the source does not state
refusal_codes.SOURCE_ROLE_CONTRADICTION: one source object carries contradictory classifications (e.g. premise vs candidate); resolve in the corpus, not in HML
refusal_codes.BACKEND_REQUIRED: the step's warrant needs a computational backend; render with UNKNOWN evidence or refuse the verification claim, never fabricate
refusal_codes.LIBRARY_REQUIRED: the step's warrant needs a theorem/domain library entry that does not exist
refusal_codes.SOURCE_AMBIGUITY: the source under-determines the state change; refusal, never a guess

representation_views.canonical: the typed semantic state; every view is a deterministic rendering of it
representation_views.losslessness: parse(render(S)) == S for every supported state, per view; HML_TREE is a view only, never canonical, and carries no superiority claim
representation_views.divergence: a distinction visible in only one view is a rendering bug

training_safe_field_policy.principle: training views are renderer-level projections of the audit record; never semantic authority
training_safe_field_policy.input_projection: (S_before, action) emitted from an explicit field allowlist
never_in_input: action.summary when answer-bearing (summaries are dropped or neutralised)
claimed_conclusion when it states the step's output
later source-solution text including via provenance payloads
derived fields trivially revealing the target
training_safe_field_policy.assertions: automated per-example leakage checks in dataset CI: no token of the held-out target in the input projection; no post-action id cited
training_safe_field_policy.audit: the full semantic record is preserved separately and linked by id

non_rules.corpus_counts: no corpus count (600, 3978, 433, ...) is a semantic rule; gates are defined over mechanisms and verdicts, not row totals
non_rules.no_procedure_keywords: no TRIG/CALCULUS/DIFFERENTIATE/etc core operations exist or are planned; mathematical procedure lives in warrants, libraries and backends
